name: Gap

prices.note: Gap Inc. product API that the category page itself calls (commerceProductsSearchUrl in the page source), read with curl and the StylodexBot UA. Women's jeans only (shorts, overalls, skirts, jackets, shirts, pants and capris excluded). Price = the store's regularPrice for colorways not marked down: priceType R, or P (a temporary promotion) without a markdown flag; priceType M and colorways flagged 'price as marked', clearance or final sale excluded. Women's jeans cid=5664, brand=gap, pages 0-6 (webProductType 'womens jeans' and 'petite jeans' kept, men's dropped). 40 styles: $79.95 (Curvy High Rise Stride Wide-Leg Ankle, High Rise Cheeky Straight) to $99.95 (some Low Rise '90s Loose and Long & Lean washes); 38 colorway prices at $89.95 (e.g. High Rise '70s Flare, The Hailey Extra Baggy Jean). Kept items carried a '60% off: limited time' promo flag.
